title: Globalize elementary semistable chart operations
statement:
Let $K$ be a separably closed field [def-kun-separably-closed, def-weil-field] and $V\subseteq K$ a valuation ring, meaning a subring with fraction field $K$ containing either $z$ or $z^{-1}$ for every $z\in K^\times$. Suppose its prime ideals form a finite chain. Put $T=\operatorname{Spec}V$, $\eta=\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $X\to T$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and of pure relative dimension one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], with smooth generic fibre [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Suppose $X$ is strictly semistable: locally on $X$ and $T$ it has an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] to $\operatorname{Spec}A[t]$ or $\operatorname{Spec}(A[u,v]/(uv-c))$ for an open $\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq T$. No separatedness or properness of $X\to T$ is assumed. Fix a closed point $x\in X$, put $s=x|_T$, and put $R=V_s$, the localization at the prime corresponding to $s$. The scheme $\operatorname{Spec}R$ is an open of $T$. Near $x$, a smooth point has an etale chart to $\operatorname{Spec}R[t]$, and a nonsmooth point has an etale chart to $\operatorname{Spec}(R[u,v]/(uv-c))$ with $0\ne c\in\mathfrak m_R$ and $u(x)=v(x)=0$.
For either of the following specified chart operations there are a strictly semistable $T$-curve $X'$ and a proper $T$-morphism $b:X'\to X$, isomorphic on the whole generic fibre, whose restriction over some open neighbourhood $W$ of $x$ is the pullback of the indicated blowup along the chosen chart:
(i) on the nodal chart, $\operatorname{Bl}_{(u,\pi)}\operatorname{Spec}(R[u,v]/(uv-c))$, for $0\ne\pi\in R$ with $c/\pi\in R$;
(ii) on the smooth chart, $\operatorname{Bl}_{(t-a,\pi)}\operatorname{Spec}R[t]$, for $a\in R$ and $0\ne\pi\in\mathfrak m_R$, provided the chart sends $x$ to the closed point $(\mathfrak m_R,t-\bar a)$.
A $T$-curve here means a flat finitely presented $T$-scheme of pure relative dimension one. A blowup along a finitely generated ideal $I$ is the scheme covered by the affine chart algebras $B[I/f]\subseteq B_f$, for generators $f$ of $I$ [def-nagata-affine-blowup, def-nagata-blowup-chart-ring, prop-nagata-affine-blowup-chart-cover]; equivalently it is the Proj of $\bigoplus_{n\ge0}I^n$. Polynomial rings use [def-weil-polynomial-ring], and properness uses [def-weil-proper-morphism].
